title: Wyvern Stinger
summary: Alchemy ingredient used to make Wyvern Toxin.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Wyvern Stingers into Ashes of Wyvern Stinger. Add any Sublimate to make Wyvern Toxin.
fields.Acquisition: Read Research Notes at the Waning Moon to find the buried brewer’s stash.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
